title: Contact and Cover
author: A. M. Yarrow
blurb: Wendell Eriksen, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
